units.synthetic_decode_tokens_per_second: aggregate output tokens/s after MTP across active cohort
units.output_tokens_per_forward_per_request: output tokens per target-model iteration per request

required_caveat: Controlled measurements do not necessarily represent real-world performance. Fixed-output ignore_eos engine-gate windows include a post-answer tail with path-dependent speculative acceptance.
upstream_throughput: Use fixed-acceptance c1_bench.py and answer-only spec_ladder_probe.py receipts rather than engine-gate output rates.
presentation: Performance tables: mean/median post-MTP output tokens/s beside mean/median forward passes/s; cold-prefill mean/median prompt tokens/s, mean/median TTFT, request count and definitions.
